description: This is the main source file for a Flutter-based dating app frontend. It includes the app entry point, root widget configuration, routing setup, enum and class definitions for filter preferences, and a filter UI page with interaction logic.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up application theme and navigation routes.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: Data class holding user filter preferences with a method to convert preferences to query parameters.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: A stateful widget providing a UI for users to set filter preferences such as ethnicity, race, hairstyle, and textual preferences.

classes.name: HairColor
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible hair color options: blonde, brunette, dyed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entrypoint that initializes and runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp widget setting up MaterialApp with routes and theme.

methods.name: toQueryParams
methods.description: Converts filter preferences into a Map of URL query parameters, omitting null or empty values.

methods.name: _apply
methods.description: Gathers current filter selections, creates a FilterPreferences object, converts it to query parameters, and displays a SnackBar.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Resets the filter selection UI to default (empty).

methods.name: _mapEthnicityToCode
methods.description: Converts display ethnicity names to internal string codes.

methods.name: _mapRaceToCode
methods.description: Converts display race names to internal string codes.

methods.name: _buildHairChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip widget for selecting hair color.
